title: Command
description: One inbound control command: a POST to ClashEngine's ControlListenUrl at path /commands as a single application/json body, authenticated with X-Api-Key. This is the write half of the control surface an external matchmaking service (web UI, Discord bot) uses to manipulate queue and match state; the response body is commandresponse.schema.json and the corresponding state changes surface on the outbound event stream (event.schema.json). Players are addressed by in-game name; queues by the registry id the event stream and snapshot use ("{ownerArena}/{baseName}", e.g. "lobby/casual_4v4"). Which extra fields are required depends on `type` (see each field's description). The engine remains the authority on validity: an eligible-looking command can still come back status=rejected (player disconnected, in a match, serving a penalty, ...).

schemaVersion.description: Wire format version of the command surface (shared with commandresponse.schema.json and snapshot.schema.json). Increment on any breaking change.

type.description: What to do. enqueue: add `player` to `queue` (expands to their in-game party exactly like ?play). enqueue_group: atomically add `players` to `queue` as one group (all-or-nothing). dequeue: remove `player` from `queue`, or from every queue when `queue` is absent. form_match: start a private/externally-formed match on `queue`'s rules with the exact `teams` rosters, bypassing the matcher. cancel_match: cancel a still-Forming match by `matchId`. set_auto: set `player`'s auto-requeue preference to `enabled`.

commandId.description: Client-supplied correlation id, echoed verbatim on the response. Optional; ClashEngine never interprets it.

player.description: In-game player name. Required for enqueue / dequeue / set_auto.

players.description: In-game player names. Required for enqueue_group. The whole set must fit on one team of the queue's shape.

queue.description: Queue registry id ("{ownerArena}/{baseName}"). Required for enqueue / enqueue_group / form_match; optional for dequeue (absent = leave every queue). For form_match this is the anchor queue whose game type, arena, and match rules the private match runs under; the rostered players need not be members of it.

teams.description: Required for form_match: the full self-organized rosters, one inner array of in-game names per team. Must match the anchor queue's shape exactly (TeamCount teams of PlayersPerTeam each). Every player must be connected, not in a match, and (unless the queue ignores penalties) not serving a timeout.

matchId.description: Required for cancel_match: the match to cancel, as carried on match.started events, form_match responses, and the snapshot. Only Forming matches (not yet at GO!) can be cancelled. The cancellation is blameless -- nobody is flagged as an abandoner and no penalties follow, since a service cancel means the organizer voided the lobby, not that players failed a readiness check.

enabled.description: Required for set_auto: the new auto-requeue preference.
